system.description:
Unlike other casters, you fight with your fist, and your mind. You wrap your arms and legs in your combat scroll providing you with a very different fighting style. You gain the following benefits:

You can now make melee attacks with your Combat Scroll as you strike with chakra covered fists and feet.

While in this stance, your [Unarmed Damage] type becomes the scrolls damage type.

In place of increasing the scrolls damage pool, you instead make a number of attacks equal to the number of dice you would roll, dealing 1d12 damage for each successful hit.

Ninjutsu or Genjutsu you cast that requires an attack, with a range greater than 5 feet, can be cast with a range of 5 feet and are treated as a melee attack. If they are, on a hit, they add 1d12 to their damage dealt once per turn, as your deliver the jutsu’s effect with a scroll covered strike.

Evocation Technique – Twin Scroll Fist. If you have a Strength modifier of +1 or higher, you can wield 2 Giant Combat Scrolls, but they must share the same damage type. While you do, you can select one Taijutsu stance you know. You can benefit from that stances base effects. You cannot benefit from their level 5 or 10 effects. You use 1d12, in place of their unarmed damage die for any effects that require it.
